name: tutor-a1-a4
description: App Android dei tratti Tutor in autostrada (TutOK), costruita con Capacitor a partire da src/

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.grafica: node tools/make-icons.mjs && npm run build && node tools/store-screenshots.mjs
